question: How many confirmed measles cases will Brazil's Ministry of Health report for 2026 by mid-September 2026?

calls.reasoning: Resolution reads a slow-updating official page, not the epidemic. The page today says 29 confirmed through EW35 (28 SP + 1 RJ) and already incorporates SP's Sep 1-2 count of 28, so it carries roughly a one-week publication lag; by Sep 18 it will most likely have advanced one or two updates covering EW36 (ends Sep 5) or EW37 (ends Sep 12). Reference class is post-elimination measles outbreaks under an active mass-vaccination response in the Americas, where weekly national increments in the decline phase run 0-4; SP's own increments have decelerated from +7 (Aug 13-20) to +3 (Aug 20-27) to +2 (Aug 27-Sep 1) after 2.5M doses in August concentrated in the three affected municipalities, campaign ending Sep 1. Two paths to a low value: no update published, or an EW36 update showing no new confirmations - together maybe 30% mass sitting exactly at 29. Upside comes from confirmation batching (the count jumped 15->23 in one week in August) and continued chain transmission in a 22M metro with 89%/75% MMR coverage, giving a fat right tail to the mid-30s. Reaching >70 needs +41 in 11 days, an order of magnitude beyond anything Brazil has recorded post-elimination (Tocantins 2025 peaked at 25 total), so escape mass is small but non-zero via a retrospective mass reclassification. Evidence is one-sided in the sense that no source found is newer than Sep 2; I stay close to the status-quo-plus-modest-drift anchor.

RESOLUTION INSTRUMENT: resolves off the cumulative 2026 'casos confirmados' figure printed on the Brazilian Ministry of Health's 'Situacao Epidemiologica do Sarampo' page (gov.br), taken from the MOST RECENT UPDATE PUBLISHED ON OR BEFORE 2026-09-18 — not off the true epidemic curve, not off Sao Paulo state's own secretariat count, and not off PAHO. Fallbacks if that page is down: Painel do Sarampo, then credible sources citing the Ministry. Only 'confirmado' 2026 cases; suspected/under-investigation/discarded excluded. Import status irrelevant.

EVENT WINDOW: accumulation runs 2026-01-01 -> the last MoH update published on or before 2026-09-18 per the criteria; as of Now (2026-09-07T23:50Z) ~96% of that Jan-1-to-Sep-18 span has elapsed. Note the reading date, not the forecast-close date, is what matters.

STATUS-QUO OUTCOME: the page as it stands right now — 'Em 2026, ate a semana epidemiologica 35, foram confirmados 29 casos sendo, 28 (96,6%) casos, registrados no estado de Sao Paulo' (gov.br MoH situacao-epidemiologica page, fetched 2026-09-07). EW35 ended 2026-08-29. No 'atualizado em' date is printed on the page and no stated update cadence was found.

EVIDENCE (both directions):
- MoH national page: 29 confirmed 2026, through EW35; 28 in Sao Paulo state (96.6%), 1 in Rio de Janeiro (gov.br, read 2026-09-07).
- SP state secretariat via Agencia Brasil, 2026-09-02: SP state reached 28 confirmed 2026 cases — 25 in the capital, 2 in Sao Bernardo do Campo, 1 in Guarulhos; the 27th and 28th (an infant and a 40-year-old woman) were confirmed Tuesday 2026-09-01.
- The MoH's 29 (=28 SP + 1 RJ) therefore already incorporates SP data as of 2026-09-01/02, i.e. the page's 'EW35' label understates how current the figure is; publication lag from event to posting appears to be roughly one week.
- SP state count trajectory in 2026, from dated media citing the state secretariat: 1st case March; 7 by June; 15 mid-Aug; 16 (CNN Brasil); 23 (~Aug 20); 26 on 2026-08-27 (Agencia Brasil/Band/Forbes Brasil, +3 that week); 28 on 2026-09-01 (+2 in 5 days).
- National count trajectory reported by media/MoH during 2026: ~2 confirmed by mid-March (a 6-month-old in SP with Bolivia travel history; a 22-year-old in RJ); ~3 by EW14; 8 by July; 24 in early August; 27 in late August (viacertanatal citing MoH); 29 by EW35.
- Downward pressure: SP applied >2.5 million measles doses during August 2026, 2.4M of them in three municipalities — Sao Paulo city 2.0M, Guarulhos 230.1k, Sao Bernardo do Campo 169.5k — under an indiscriminate campaign for ages 6 months to 59 years plus the National Multivaccination Campaign, which RAN Aug 3 to Sep 1, 2026 and has now ENDED (Agencia Brasil 2026-09-02).
- Upward pressure: 24 of the confirmed cases belong to a single active transmission chain that began in June in SP; 20 of 28 SP patients had no vaccination record, and 19 were unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated. SP preliminary 2026 coverage: 89.35% first dose, 74.64% second dose, against a 95% target. Measles serial interval ~11-14 days, so confirmations posted in mid-September reflect late-August exposures.
- Regional context: PAHO reported 43,559 confirmed cases in the Americas across EW1-EW27 2026 from 17 countries, a 3.8x increase over the same period of 2025, concentrated in Guatemala (27,145), Mexico (12,052), USA (2,231), Canada (1,097); PAHO issued an epidemiological alert 2026-02-03 and MoH issued a national alert in August. Importation pressure into Brazil is elevated; MoH had separately warned in April 2026 of post-World-Cup importation risk.
- Baseline: Brazil confirmed 38 measles cases in all of 2025 (including a 25-case Tocantins outbreak), all import-related and controlled; PAHO recertified Brazil as having eliminated endemic transmission in November 2024; no measles deaths in Brazil since 2020.
- Rio Grande do Sul: zero confirmed 2026 cases as of early September 2026 (last cases were single imported cases in 2024 and 2025 with no secondary transmission).
- Precedent for batch/step increments: the SP count moved 15 -> 23 within roughly one week in mid-August, so single-week jumps of ~8 have occurred in this same outbreak; other weeks in 2026 (Jan-Apr) saw zero increments for a month or more.

BASE RATES FOUND (with the class each is over):
- Over ALL of 2026 to date (EW1-EW35, ~35 weeks): 29 confirmed nationally = ~0.83 cases/week average.
- Over the CONDITIONAL class 'weeks since the SP chain began in June 2026': ~28 SP cases across ~13 weeks = ~2.2/week.
- Over the NARROWER conditional class 'the four most recent observed intervals (Aug 13 -> Sep 1), i.e. after the mass campaign started': +7, +3, +2 over ~19 days = ~2.2-2.5/week and decelerating.
- Over the class 'Jan-Apr 2026 weeks, no active chain': ~0.1/week.
- Over the class 'full-year Brazilian national confirmed totals post-elimination': 38 in 2025, and 2026 stands at 29 through EW35.

SEARCHED FOR BUT COULD NOT FIND: (a) any MoH or SP-state update dated after 2026-09-02 — no EW36 or EW37 figure exists in any source retrieved on 2026-09-07; (b) any printed 'atualizado em' timestamp or stated refresh cadence on the MoH situacao-epidemiologica page; (c) a PAHO situation report later than the 2026-07-17 one (EW27) giving a Brazil-specific count; (d) any current count of Brazilian suspected/under-investigation measles cases (only a March 2026 figure of 232 suspected nationally was found); (e) any prediction market on Brazilian measles — Polymarket's ~102 measles markets are US-scoped, Manifold and Kalshi returned nothing, and Brazil blocked Polymarket/Kalshi domestically under CMN Resolution 5.298 in April 2026.

MANIPULATION SIGNALS: none observed in the retrieved material.

Reference class is the 2026 growth of this same series: late-August pace was +2-3/week, decelerating (26 on Aug 27, 28 on Sep 1), against a base of ~+3/2 weeks outside the August surge. Two weeks of accrual to whatever week is published by Sep 18 implies a median increment of about +3. calls.reasoning: Resolution reads the MoH page's latest 2026 figure published on/before 18 Sep; it currently states 29 confirmed through EW35, matching SP state's 1 Sep balance (28 SP + 1 RJ). Reference class: 2-week-ahead changes in this same running national count during 2026, plus Brazil's 2025 full-year total of 38 as a scale check. Recent rate is ~1-1.5 confirmed/week and decelerating (16 SP on 4 Aug, 23 on 7 Aug, 26 ~25 Aug, 28 on 1 Sep), so ~1.5-2.5 weeks of further accrual implies roughly +2 to +4, i.e. a low-30s central value. Two things pull toward the floor: a real chance the page's next refresh falls after 18 Sep (leaving 29 as the published figure), and 2.5M vaccine doses in SP during August suppressing the three chains still under surveillance. Pulling up: three chains remain active, 20 of 28 SP cases were unvaccinated/incompletely vaccinated, and confirmation lags mean early-September infections post after the deadline only partly. Distribution is therefore heavily right-skewed off a hard 29 floor. Upper escape past 70 needs +41 in ~two weeks, ~20x the current rate — priced at 1% for an unrecognised low-coverage cluster plus bulk reclassification of the investigation backlog. No prediction market prices this; evidence is one-sided only in that all sources trace to the same MoH/SP-secretariat pipeline.

EVIDENCE
- MoH page, fetched 2026-09-07: 'Em 2026, até a semana epidemiológica 35, foram confirmados 29 casos' — 28 in São Paulo (96.6%), 1 in Rio de Janeiro (3.4%). SP breakdown: 25 capital, 2 São Bernardo do Campo, 1 Guarulhos; 2 imported, 26 unknown source. RJ case: unknown source, no vaccination record.
- Brazilian epi week 35 of 2026 runs 30 Aug - 5 Sep; the page carried EW35 data within ~2 days of week close, and the figure aligns with SP state's balance released 1 Sep — indicating a short publication lag rather than a monthly cadence. No 'última atualização' stamp and no stated update frequency appear on the page (searched, absent).
- Agência Brasil, 2 Sep 2026: SP state reached 28 confirmed cases; two added on Tue 1 Sep (an infant under 1 and a woman in her 40s).
- Metrópoles, 1 Sep 2026: four transmission chains identified in SP in 2026. The March-April chain (two imported cases) was closed after 12 weeks with no linked cases. The June, July and August chains remain under state and municipal surveillance. 20 of 28 cases had no vaccination record or an incomplete schedule.
- CNN Brasil, 7 Aug 2026: SP recorded its 23rd case; 'até a última segunda-feira (4), havia 16 casos' — +7 in three days, the sharpest observed jump of the year.
- Series of SP state counts through the year: 15 (late Jul, Bom Dia Brasil), 16 (4 Aug), 23 (7 Aug), 26 (~25 Aug, Agência Brasil), 28 (1 Sep). National count = SP + 1 RJ throughout.
- National count milestones per MoH: ~3 by EW14 (late Apr), 8 by July, 24 in early Aug, 27 mid-Aug, 29 at EW35.
- SP vaccination response: >2.5M measles doses in August, 2.4M of them in three municipalities (capital 2.0M, Guarulhos 230.1k, São Bernardo 169.5k); 'dose zero' for infants 6-11 months in affected municipalities. The multivaccination campaign closed 1 Sep 2026; routine UBS vaccination continues.
- Rio Grande do Sul (CEVS, alert issued early Sep 2026): zero confirmed 2026 cases; last confirmed were imported singles in 2024 and 2025 (travel history to Asia and the US) with no secondary transmission. Porto Alegre's municipal health service issued a network alert on the SP cases.
- PAHO issued a regional measles epidemiological alert for the Americas (3 Feb 2026); MoH issued a separate warning in April 2026 about post-World Cup importation risk. Brazil lost the regional elimination certification for the Americas on account of outbreaks in the US, Canada and Mexico; MoH states Brazil's own no-endemic-circulation status is unchanged.
- BASE RATES. Over all of 2026 to date (EW14-EW35, MoH figures): 2-week changes in the national count range from 0 (multiple stretches Jan-Jun) to about +9 (late Jul - early Aug). Conditional on the last four weeks — i.e. after the mass campaign began and with three chains under surveillance — the observed rate is +1 to +1.5 per week (24 -> 27 -> 29 across ~25 days). Conditional on the expansion phase only (mid-Jul to 7 Aug), the rate was ~+4/week. Full-year comparators: 2025 Brazil = 38 confirmed (including a 25-case Tocantins outbreak); 2026 to EW35 = 29.
- Event-in-window check, 2-week windows over the last ~14 months: windows containing at least one new confirmed national case are a minority in 2025 (38 cases clustered mainly in one outbreak) but are the clear majority since June 2026, when continuous SP transmission began.
- COUNTER-DIRECTION: 26 of 29 cases are of unknown source, meaning undetected chains; the SP capital chain has produced cases in every month since June; measles serial interval ~14 days, so August-chain exposures generate confirmations into mid-September.
- COUNTER-DIRECTION (other way): the first SP chain was formally closed after 12 weeks silence, showing chains do terminate here; laboratory confirmation lag means infections in the final days before 18 Sep will not appear in a figure published by then.

calls.reasoning: The page reads 29 through SE35. SE35 = Aug 30-Sep 5 by Brazilian epi-week arithmetic (SE1 2026 = Jan 4-10), so the Sep 7 fetch shows a ~2-day publication lag, not a week: the 29 already counts Sep 2-5 at zero new, and exactly one more update (SE36, Sep 6-12, posting ~Sep 14-15) lands before Sep 18; SE37 closes Sep 19, too late. Recent pace is ~2 confirmed/week and decelerating (SP 16 on Aug 4, 23 on Aug 7, 26 on Aug 27, 28 on Sep 1) after 2.5M doses in the three affected municipalities, campaign closed Sep 1. Median is therefore 29 + one modest weekly increment = 31, with ~30% of mass sitting on the 29 floor (zero-increment refresh, or no refresh at all) and a fat right tail from the confirmation backlog and retrospective additions. Main counterargument: 26 of 29 cases are of unknown source with three chains still under surveillance, and serial-interval math puts late-August exposures into mid-September confirmations - that is what the mid-30s tail buys.
calls.reconciliation: Disputed: (a) SE35's date range, (b) the page's publication lag, (c) whether a refresh occurs before Sep 18, (d) increment rate, (e) tail width. (a) is factual and I settled it by calendar arithmetic without web access: the week containing Jan 1 2026 has only 3 January days, so SE1 2026 = Jan 4-10 and SE35 = Aug 30-Sep 5. Runs 1 and 2 had it as Aug 23-29 and consequently had to explain why an 'EW35' figure contained SP's Sep 1 balance; Run 3's reading needs no such patch, which is independent corroboration. (b) follows: ~2-day lag, so the cadence looks weekly and P(no refresh) is lower than Runs 1/3 assumed - but the offsetting correction is that Sep 2-5 is already counted at zero, and only ONE update fits before the deadline rather than two, which caps the tail. These two corrections roughly cancel at the median and net-tighten the upper tail versus Run 2. (c) could not be settled - no run found an 'atualizado em' stamp or a stated cadence, so it stays priced rather than decided. (d) is pure judgment over identical numbers; 26->28 SP over Aug 27-Sep 1 is ~2/week, so I took Runs 1/2's reading over Run 3's ~1-1.5. (e) I adopt neither 7 nor 10.5: one publication window with a real batch-confirmation precedent gives 8.35. I carried forward Run 3's framing of the resolution instrument and all runs' 1-2.5% escape reasoning, landing at 1%. Market check: no web access this run; all three runs independently found no Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi/bookmaker contract on Brazilian measles counts - none found, so no blend.
